name: Maitri Enterprises Limited
about: Maitri Enterprises Limited primarily engages in the trading of pharmaceutical and medical goods in India. It operates through two segments: Sale of Services and Pharmaceutical Goods. The company also engages in the sale of services by way of a works contract. The company also offers infrastructure, construction, real estate activities, office spaces, residential, retail leasing, and green developments. The company was formerly known as Parth Alluminium Limited and changed its name to Maitri Enterprises Limited in December 2016. Maitri Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
